architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management lib (use React context for global state). API client in src/api/.

tickets.title: Create Beranda (Home) page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch beranda_home screen to React component. Match layout, colors, typography. Use Tailwind classes. Extract reusable components (e.g., product cards, banners) to src/components/.

tickets.title: Create Masuk (Login) and Daftar Akun (Register) pages
tickets.description: Build login and registration forms. Match Stitch design. Add form validation (client-side). Connect to auth API. Store JWT in httpOnly cookie. Redirect logic: post-login to beranda, post-register to masuk.

tickets.title: Create Detail Produk (Product Detail) and Detail Event Katalog (Event Detail) pages
tickets.description: Convert product and event detail screens. Match layout, images, buttons. Add quantity selector, add-to-cart button. Fetch data from API. Handle loading/error states.
acceptance_criteria: Add-to-cart button triggers cart context update

tickets.title: Create Daftar Pesanan Saya (My Orders) and Detail Pesanan (Order Detail) pages
tickets.description: Build order listing and detail screens. Match Stitch design. Fetch orders from API. Status badges (e.g., 'Diproses', 'Dikirim'). Cancellation request button links to ajukan_pembatalan.
acceptance_criteria: Order list matches Stitch design (cards, status badges)
Cancellation button links to ajukan_pembatalan with order ID

tickets.title: Create Upload Bukti Pembayaran (Payment Proof) and Pesanan Berhasil (Success) pages
tickets.description: Build payment proof upload form. Match Stitch design. File upload to API (POST /orders/:id/payment-proof). Success page shows order summary. Redirect logic: post-upload to pesanan_berhasil.
acceptance_criteria: File upload form matches Stitch design

tickets.title: Create Ajukan Pembatalan (Cancellation Request) and Notifikasi (Notifications) pages
tickets.description: Build cancellation request form. Match Stitch design. Submit to API (POST /orders/:id/cancellation). Notifications page lists alerts. Mark-as-read API (PATCH /notifications/:id).
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation form matches Stitch design (reason dropdown, notes field)

tickets.title: Create Schedule Calendar and Admin Dashboard Overview pages
tickets.description: Build calendar view for events. Match Stitch design. Use react-big-calendar. Admin dashboard shows stats, charts. Fetch data from API. Role-based access (admin only).
acceptance_criteria: Calendar matches Stitch design (events, date picker)

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App shell. Add navigation bar (match Stitch design). Set up React Router v6 routes. Lazy-load pages. Auth context for user state. 404 page. Global error boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation bar matches Stitch design (active state, mobile menu)
